title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 2

blocks.source_text: Hi there! It is time for the second snapshot for 26.4, featuring improved render distance fog, a new celestial occluder, and a fresh redesign of the F3 screen.
blocks.translated_text: 大家好！26.4版本的第二个快照来了，其中包含改进的渲染距离雾效、新的天文物体遮挡器，以及F3屏幕的重新设计。

blocks.source_text: Happy mining!
blocks.translated_text: 祝大家采矿愉快！

blocks.source_text: Changes
blocks.translated_text: 改动说明

blocks.source_text: When "Improved Transparency" is on, sky background and clouds that are behind the terrain are now blended into the terrain render distance fog making the boundary between the sky and the terrain invisible
blocks.translated_text: 当“提高透明度”功能开启时，天空背景和地形背后的云层会融入到地形渲染的雾效中，使得天空与地形之间的边界变得不可见

blocks.source_text: In the Overworld, the bottom half of the skybox is now occluding the celestial objects such as the sun, the moon and the stars
blocks.translated_text: 在主世界中，天空盒的底部现在会遮挡太阳、月亮和星星等天体

blocks.source_text: UI
blocks.translated_text: 用户界面

blocks.source_text: The debug overlay (F3 by default) has been redesigned to be easier to read and understand
blocks.translated_text: 调试覆盖层（默认使用F3键显示）经过重新设计，变得更易于阅读和理解

blocks.source_text: Technical Changes
blocks.translated_text: 技术改动

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 122.1
blocks.translated_text: 数据包的版本号现在为122.1

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 99.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包的版本号现在为99.0

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Version 122.1
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本 122.1

blocks.source_text: New Environment Attributes
blocks.translated_text: 新的环境属性

blocks.source_text: minecraft:visual/has_sky_occluder
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:visual/has_sky_occluder

blocks.source_text: Determines whether the sky occluder is enabled for the environment. The sky occluder will occlude the sky box up until a certain angle with fog color with a smooth occlusion border.
blocks.translated_text: 决定是否为该环境启用天空遮蔽器。天空遮蔽器会将天空盒在达到某个角度之前用雾色进行遮挡，并带有平滑的阴影边界。”

blocks.source_text: Value type: boolean
blocks.translated_text: 数据类型：布尔值

blocks.source_text: Default value: true for the Overworld, false for the Nether and the End
blocks.translated_text: 默认值：主世界为 true，下界和末地分别为 false

blocks.source_text: Interpolated: no
blocks.translated_text: 插值方式：否

blocks.source_text: Predicates
blocks.translated_text: 谓词

blocks.source_text: Added below_heightmap:
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 below_heightmap 属性

blocks.source_text: Checks if the height of the position is below a given heightmap value.
blocks.translated_text: 检查当前位置的海拔是否低于给定的高度图值

blocks.source_text: Format:
blocks.translated_text: 格式：

blocks.source_text: heightmap : Heightmap type to compare origin against
blocks.translated_text: heightmap：用于比较原始值的高度图类型

blocks.source_text: Resource Pack Version 99.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包版本 99.0

blocks.source_text: Shaders & Post-process Effects
blocks.translated_text: 着色器与后期处理效果

blocks.source_text: screenquad.vsh was renamed to screentriangle.vsh since it was actually representing a single triangle for a while now
blocks.translated_text: screenquad.vsh 被重命名为 screentriangle.vsh，因为它实际上一直表示单个三角形

blocks.source_text: Changes for the "Improved Fog" feature that is controlled by the "Improved Transparency" video setting
blocks.translated_text: 针对“改进的雾效”功能所做的更改，该效果由“改进的透明度”视频设置控制

blocks.source_text: Removed OIT (Order-Independent Transparency, controlled by "Improved Transparency" video setting) support from the clouds.fsh , since it is now used to render clouds when OIT is off and to render clouds to an offscreen target when OIT is on
blocks.translated_text: 从 clouds.fsh 中移除了 OIT（顺序无关透明度，由“改进的透明度”视频设置控制）的支持，因为现在当 OIT 关闭时使用该功能来渲染云层，而当 OIT 开启时则将云层渲染到离屏幕的目标区域

blocks.source_text: Added blit_clouds.fsh shader with OIT support that renders clouds from an offscreen target to OIT targets
blocks.translated_text: 添加了支持 OIT 的 blit_clouds.fsh 着色器，可以从离屏幕的目标区域将云层渲染到 OIT 目标区域

blocks.source_text: New Shaders for the Sky Occlusion
blocks.translated_text: 新的天空遮挡着色器

blocks.source_text: Added sky_occluder.vsh and sky_occluder.fsh shaders which are used to occlude the sky box up until the certain angle with fog color with a smooth occlusion border
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 sky_occluder.vsh 和 sky_occluder.fsh 着色器，它们用于在达到特定角度之前用雾色遮挡天空盒，并生成平滑的遮挡边界

blocks.source_text: Get the Snapshot
blocks.translated_text: 获取快照

blocks.source_text: Snapshots are available for Minecraft: Java Edition. To install the Snapshot, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download) and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab.
blocks.translated_text: Java版的Minecraft支持使用快照。要安装快照，请打开[Minecraft启动器](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download)，并在"Installations"选项卡中启用快照功能。

content:
Hi there! It is time for the second snapshot for 26.4, featuring improved render distance fog, a new celestial occluder, and a fresh redesign of the F3 screen.

Happy mining!

Changes

When "Improved Transparency" is on, sky background and clouds that are behind the terrain are now blended into the terrain render distance fog making the boundary between the sky and the terrain invisible

In the Overworld, the bottom half of the skybox is now occluding the celestial objects such as the sun, the moon and the stars

UI

The debug overlay (F3 by default) has been redesigned to be easier to read and understand

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 122.1

The Resource Pack version is now 99.0

Data Pack Version 122.1

New Environment Attributes

minecraft:visual/has_sky_occluder

Determines whether the sky occluder is enabled for the environment. The sky occluder will occlude the sky box up until a certain angle with fog color with a smooth occlusion border.

Value type: boolean

Default value: true for the Overworld, false for the Nether and the End

Interpolated: no

Predicates

Added below_heightmap:

Checks if the height of the position is below a given heightmap value.

Format:

heightmap : Heightmap type to compare origin against

Resource Pack Version 99.0

Shaders & Post-process Effects

screenquad.vsh was renamed to screentriangle.vsh since it was actually representing a single triangle for a while now

Changes for the "Improved Fog" feature that is controlled by the "Improved Transparency" video setting

Removed OIT (Order-Independent Transparency, controlled by "Improved Transparency" video setting) support from the clouds.fsh , since it is now used to render clouds when OIT is off and to render clouds to an offscreen target when OIT is on

Added blit_clouds.fsh shader with OIT support that renders clouds from an offscreen target to OIT targets

New Shaders for the Sky Occlusion

Added sky_occluder.vsh and sky_occluder.fsh shaders which are used to occlude the sky box up until the certain angle with fog color with a smooth occlusion border

Fixed bugs in 26.4 Snapshot 2

[MC-184161](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-184161) - The "Oh Shiny" advancement title is missing a comma

[MC-212623](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-212623) - Some closed captions use the word "angers" as a verb, therefore making them grammatically incorrect

[MC-236052](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-236052) - Z-fighting can be seen around the necks of small armor stands

[MC-300250](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-300250) - Clouds render behind foggy terrain

[MC-311977](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311977) - The closed caption for riding zombie nautiluses is "Nautilus bubbles"

[MC-312035](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312035) - Attacking an entity in Creative mode, then switching to Survival mode adds 5 ticks of block break delay

[MC-312066](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312066) - Donkeys, horses and mules in water can no longer be ridden onto land without the aid of a partial block

[MC-312068](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312068) - Some strings are missing articles before the word "invalid"

[MC-312079](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312079) - The options.fullscreen.unavailable string is improperly capitalized, unlike similar strings

[MC-312080](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312080) - The telemetry.event.world_loaded.description string is improperly capitalized, unlike similar strings

[MC-312082](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312082) - The advancements.husbandry.uh_oh.title string is missing a hyphen between the words "Uh" and "Oh"

[MC-312084](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312084) - The options.fullscreen.entry string is missing a hyphen before the word "bit"

[MC-312087](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312087) - The word "towards" within the options.vignette.tooltip string isn't spelled in American English

[MC-312088](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312088) - Some application control key name strings are displayed without the "AC" prefix, unlike similar strings

[MC-312089](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312089) - Some strings that name screens are improperly capitalized, unlike similar strings

[MC-312091](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312091) - The chat.copy.click string is improperly capitalized, unlike similar strings

[MC-312092](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312092) - The multiplayer.socialInteractions.not_available string is improperly capitalized, unlike similar strings

[MC-312102](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312102) - The disconnect.loginFailedInfo.invalidSession string is improperly capitalized, unlike similar strings

[MC-312103](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312103) - The entity name "Experience Orbs" isn't capitalized within some game rule description strings, unlike similar strings

[MC-312107](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312107) - The selectWorld.backupQuestion.experimental string is improperly capitalized, unlike similar strings

[MC-312108](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312108) - The jigsaw_block.final_state string is improperly capitalized, unlike similar strings

[MC-312111](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312111) - Some Realms snapshot popup strings are improperly capitalized, unlike similar strings

[MC-312112](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312112) - The mco.configure.world.invite_codes.subtitle string uses the verb "add" instead of "create", unlike similar strings

[MC-312126](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312126) - The options.inGameNotification.tooltip string is improperly capitalized, unlike similar strings

Get the Snapshot

Snapshots are available for Minecraft: Java Edition. To install the Snapshot, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download) and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab.

For any feedback and suggestions, head over to the [Feedback site](https://feedback.minecraft.net/) . If you're feeling chatty, join us over at the [official Minecraft Discord](https://discordapp.com/invite/minecraft) .

大家好！26.4版本的第二个快照来了，其中包含改进的渲染距离雾效、新的天文物体遮挡器，以及F3屏幕的重新设计。

祝大家采矿愉快！

改动说明

当“提高透明度”功能开启时，天空背景和地形背后的云层会融入到地形渲染的雾效中，使得天空与地形之间的边界变得不可见

在主世界中，天空盒的底部现在会遮挡太阳、月亮和星星等天体

用户界面

调试覆盖层（默认使用F3键显示）经过重新设计，变得更易于阅读和理解

技术改动

数据包的版本号现在为122.1

资源包的版本号现在为99.0

数据包版本 122.1

新的环境属性

minecraft:visual/has_sky_occluder

决定是否为该环境启用天空遮蔽器。天空遮蔽器会将天空盒在达到某个角度之前用雾色进行遮挡，并带有平滑的阴影边界。”

数据类型：布尔值

默认值：主世界为 true，下界和末地分别为 false

插值方式：否

谓词

新增了 below_heightmap 属性

检查当前位置的海拔是否低于给定的高度图值

格式：

heightmap：用于比较原始值的高度图类型

资源包版本 99.0

着色器与后期处理效果

screenquad.vsh 被重命名为 screentriangle.vsh，因为它实际上一直表示单个三角形

针对“改进的雾效”功能所做的更改，该效果由“改进的透明度”视频设置控制

从 clouds.fsh 中移除了 OIT（顺序无关透明度，由“改进的透明度”视频设置控制）的支持，因为现在当 OIT 关闭时使用该功能来渲染云层，而当 OIT 开启时则将云层渲染到离屏幕的目标区域

添加了支持 OIT 的 blit_clouds.fsh 着色器，可以从离屏幕的目标区域将云层渲染到 OIT 目标区域

新的天空遮挡着色器

添加了 sky_occluder.vsh 和 sky_occluder.fsh 着色器，它们用于在达到特定角度之前用雾色遮挡天空盒，并生成平滑的遮挡边界

修复了 26.4 快照 2 中的漏洞

[MC-152504](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-152504) - 天空在水下时会与雾层重叠，特别是在日出和日落时

[MC-184161](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-184161) - “Oh Shiny” 进度奖励的标题缺少逗号

[MC-195836](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-195836) - 一些字幕的时态不正确或格式有误

[MC-212623](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-212623) - 一些字幕中 “angers” 被用作动词，导致语法错误

[MC-236052] - 在小型盔甲架的颈部周围可以看到Z轴方向的碰撞效果

[MC-264274] - 放置睡莲和水蛙并不会增加相关方块的使用统计数

[MC-300250] - 云层会显示在雾状地形后面

[MC-300894] - 幼年快乐恶魂身上的背带层比例错误

[MC-310503] - LivingEntity的构造函数使用弧度而非度数来随机化yaw值

[MC-311424] - 在某些输入方式下，右 Shift 键会被识别为“未知键”（“未绑定”）

[MC-311451] - 在 Wayland 环境下，处于负坐标位置的显示器无法识别鼠标输入

[MC-311458] - 'Adventure' 游戏模式的图标与游戏模式切换器中的图标不一致

[MC-311780] - 三角函数在应用之前不会对角度进行取模处理，因此不具备完整的周期性

[MC-311781](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311781) - 在全屏模式下失去焦点时，游戏窗口不会最小化

[MC-311826](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311826) - 在某些系统上，当全屏模式下使用“切换电影相机”键（该键未绑定任何功能）时，切换显示/隐藏游戏窗口的操作会触发该键的功能
